response.description: Eligible SaaS products on Microsoft Marketplace now support a simplified purchase experience in Azure portal. Customers can review plan, billing, resource group, contact details, and terms information on a single page for completing the purchase. This experience isn’t currently supported for SaaS offers that use a custom purchasing experience (i.e. Azure native integrations, Model-as-a-Service, Secure Exchange products, etc.).Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: Single-click purchase for public SaaS offers
